get.description: The rendezvous key. Both players in a fixture receive a token carrying the SAME match_id; the publisher's own matchmaker groups whoever presents it. post.description: The integrated path. Sign the RAW JSON body with the game's shared secret and send it as X-PlayCarys-Signature (sha256=<hex>). Signing the whole body rather than a few fields is what stops a replay with the winner swapped. This is the first thing that has ever actually used Game.webhook_url's secret.

info.title: PlayCarys OMGMP API
info.description: The Online Multiplayer Game Management Platform Backend API

email.description: The email address of the user

role_id.description: Optional. Which account to sign in to when one email holds more than one (4 = Player, 5 = Publisher). Omit and the password decides.

force.description: Take the account even though another session currently holds it. Only meant to be sent after the caller has confirmed that with a human (handoff approval or an explicit "sign in anyway") — omit it for a normal login attempt.

role_id.description: Which account, when one address holds both (4 = Player, 5 = Publisher).

current_password.description: The password currently on the account

user_id.description: Internal ID of the signed-in user

session_token.description: The session token issued when this tab signed in

role_id.description: Identifier mapping to internal DB roles (default: 4 = Player, 5 = Publisher)

hosting_type.description: How the game is delivered to players

game_url.description: Self-hosted games only: absolute URL of the publisher-hosted build

webhook_url.description: Optional endpoint that receives match events

max_carys_per_match.description: Most Carys one match may award a player (0-1000). The server clamps anything a match reports above this.

game_name.description: The display name of the game

game_publisher.description: Internal ID of the Publisher User

hosting_type.description: How the game is delivered to players

game_url.description: Self-hosted games only: absolute URL of the publisher-hosted build

webhook_url.description: Optional endpoint that receives match events

max_carys_per_match.description: Most Carys one match may award a player (0-1000). The server clamps anything a match reports above this.

reviewer_id.description: user_id of the admin making the decision

note.description: Reviewer note. Required when rejecting — it is what the publisher is shown.
note.example: index.html loads a script from an external CDN; please bundle it.

override_note.description: Superuser only: justification for approving a build whose security scan failed. Recorded on the review.

publisher_id.description: Owning publisher, for the ownership check

budget_carys.description: Raise this GAME's lifetime Carys budget as part of the decision. Use when a game genuinely warrants more than the default, rather than approving past the cap.

budget_xp.description: Raise this game's lifetime XP budget.

description.example: Play your first match on PlayCarys.

rule.description: What the platform measures. first_match | matches_played | friends | first_tournament

threshold.description: Threshold for the rule, e.g. 5 friends.

code.description: The code the game declared at publish time

session_id.description: Match this was earned in, if any

title.description: A title the player has earned, or null to clear

currency.description: Which currency to pay in. INR is simulated — no gateway is involved, but the transaction states are real.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safe key; a repeat is refused, not charged twice

game_id.description: The game played — sets the multiplier and the payout cap

session_id.description: Session this match belongs to, for the ledger reference

period.description: Label for the period being closed, e.g. "2026-08"

min_paise.description: Override the minimum payout threshold (staff only)

user_id.description: The user answering. Must be the recipient of the request.

action.description: Either answer notifies the requester. Rejecting used to be silent, which left the requester waiting on an answer that had already been given.

user_id.description: The RECIPIENT acknowledging receipt. Delivery is only ever claimed by the receiving client, never assumed by the sender.

from_user.description: Limit the ack to one conversation. Omit to ack everything addressed to me.

user_id.description: The player whose save this is.

data.description: The save blob. Send an object or a JSON string — the platform stores it as an opaque string and never inspects it. What goes in it is entirely the game's business: coins, diamonds, unlocked levels, settings.

winner_id.description: Who won. Must be one of the two players actually drawn into this fixture — a publisher may report an outcome, not invent a participant.

score.description: Publisher's own score line, for the record.

user_id.description: The OPPONENT confirming. The reporter cannot confirm their own report.

reason.example: I won 3-1; the reported result is wrong.

organizer_id.description: The organizer. Their decision is final.
